script: The most attractive women don't get approached by anyone, because everyone assumes she's taken. Here are three steps to break that wall. Everyone looks at her, nobody approaches. Her beauty became a wall they built in their own heads. Step one: the opener. Don't start with her looks. Say: I saw your story from a place. Is it really worth it, or does it just look nice? That disarmed her. Step two: real curiosity. Ask about what she said, because really listening is what separates you from other men. Step three: Make a short, concrete plan. If she doesn't reply, don't insist. Comment the word WALL, and I'll send you my free playbook.
